# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

import hourglass.merging
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.parsing


def find_gaps(worked, opening):
    """Label each uncovered stretch of opening, e.g. "gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)".

    Raises ValueError when any worked span sticks out of opening hours.
    """
    spans = list(worked)
    for span in spans:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ValueError(
                "worked span "
                + hourglass.parsing.format_span(span)
                + " is outside opening hours "
                + hourglass.parsing.format_span(opening)
            )

    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans):
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_gap_label(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_gap_label(cursor, opening.end))
    return labels


def _gap_label(start, end):
    gap = hourglass.models.Span(start, end)
    return "gap " + hourglass.parsing.format_span(gap) + " (" + str(gap.minutes) + " min)"
# end of file
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest

import hourglass.gaps
import hourglass.parsing

OPENING = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")


def spans_of(*texts):
    result = []
    for text in texts:
        result.append(hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text))
    return result


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_middle_gap_is_labelled(self):
        """A hole between two spans gives one label."""
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(
            spans_of("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"), OPENING
        )
        self.assertTrue(found == ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_no_workers_gives_whole_day(self):
        """With nobody working the whole opening span is a gap."""
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([], OPENING)
        self.assertTrue(found == ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_full_cover_gives_nothing(self):
        """Full coverage leaves no gaps."""
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(spans_of("09:00-17:00"), OPENING)
        self.assertFalse(found)

    def test_overlaps_count_once(self):
        """Overlapping and touching spans leave no false gap."""
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(
            spans_of("09:00-13:00", "12:00-15:00", "15:00-17:00"), OPENING
        )
        self.assertFalse(found)

    def test_edge_gaps(self):
        """Gaps at the start and end are both reported in order."""
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(spans_of("10:00-16:30"), OPENING)
        self.assertTrue(
            found == ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 16:30-17:00 (30 min)"]
        )

    def test_early_span_raises(self):
        """A span starting before opening raises."""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(spans_of("08:00-12:00"), OPENING)

    def test_late_span_raises(self):
        """A span ending after closing raises."""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(spans_of("12:00-18:00"), OPENING)
# end of file
EOF
